collection.description: A villager with a lavastone necklace can work all day without tiring, but a friend thinks they look thin.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has had a lavastone set into a necklace. Since (subject.he/she) started wearing it, (subject.he/she) has been able to work all day without tiring: building, carrying, digging, as fresh at sunset as at dawn. (subject.He/She) has done more in a week than (subject.he/she) usually does in a month. (friend) has noticed (subject.he/she) looks a little thin.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) keeps wearing it. (subject.He/She) keeps working. Then one morning (subject.he/she) simply can't get up. Every bit of tiredness from the whole week seems to land on (subject.him/her) at once. (subject.He/She) sleeps for two days. When (subject.he/she) wakes, (subject.he/she) takes the necklace off and puts it in a box. The work (subject.he/she) did is still there, and good.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (subject) takes it off, a little reluctantly. That night (subject.he/she) sleeps deeply, and wakes up stiff and ordinary and tired, like everyone else. It's a strange relief. (subject.He/She) keeps the necklace for days when (subject.he/she) really needs it, and finds there are fewer of those than (subject.he/she) expected.
